## TL;DR

Healthy board and pipeline cards no longer append “active N ago” or inline elapsed time on the status line. Recency lives in the shared `data-tip` tooltip on hover, focus, short tap, and long-press. Silent and stuck tasks still surface recency inline. This session restores `repoos.toml` and unrelated task work files from `main` so handoff stops failing on stray config drift, and aligns pipeline elapsed hiding with `displayState` rather than the raw `state` prop.

## Work and rationale

The bundle item (#1058 E1) targets noise on running cards: lines like “CONFIRMING HANDOFF · ACTIVE JUST NOW” or “CODING · ACTIVE 1M AGO” almost always read as recent, wrap onto two lines, and crowd out the signal when a task has actually gone quiet (“SILENT 6M”, “STUCK”).

The implementation centralises popover copy in `card-activity-recency.ts` and threads an optional `activityTip` through `retryHints` / `TaskCard` hints. Inline labels for healthy running work omit activity suffixes; `data-tip` carries `cardHintDataTip(title, activityTip)` so the existing global `.app-tooltip` delegate renders last-activity text plus the explanatory title. `active-task-card.ts` drops the duplicate “coding · active …” suffix for consistency with #1057’s shared status work. Pipeline rows in the `ok` display state hide the compact elapsed column and attach `stateElapsedTip` to the step label instead; stuck and other non-ok display states keep elapsed visible on the line.

Review round 1 flagged touch: the tooltip previously hid on capture-phase `pointerdown`, so touch never reached hover/focus. Round 2 extended `installTooltips()` with pinned touch opens (500 ms long-press or short tap release), outside-tap dismiss, and move-to-cancel during long-press. `tooltip-touch.test.ts` locks that behaviour in jsdom.

## Approaches tried

Touch handling was implemented once in `tooltip.ts` rather than per-card listeners so every `data-tip` site—including hints, held badges, and pipeline steps—gains the same affordances. Radix popovers on each hint were avoided as heavier than extending the body-level tooltip the board already uses.

For pipeline elapsed visibility, using `props.state` alone was insufficient when `resolveSharedTaskCardStatus` maps a row to `paused` while the incoming prop stayed `ok`; switching `showElapsedInline` to `displayState !== "ok"` keeps inline elapsed aligned with what the card actually shows.

## Challenges and blockers

Several handoffs failed on environmental gates: `repoos.toml` on the task branch diverged from `main` (local agent model overrides), and the branch carried unrelated diffs in `repo-log`, `integration-orchestrator`, other tasks’ `work/*.md`, and docs from parallel work. Those paths were checked out from `main` so the feature diff is limited to #1058 sources and this task’s own work file/reports. Prior check runs also hit server-side finalization timeouts; scoped `repoos check --changed main` remains the engineer self-check.

Vitest tooltip tests must preserve the singleton `.app-tooltip` node across cases because `installTooltips` is idempotent—clearing `document.body` removes the popup element while listeners stay registered.

## Key learnings

When a global delegate owns tooltip visibility, touch-specific open paths must not lose to an unconditional `pointerdown` hide; otherwise mobile users never see delegated hints even when desktop hover works.

Handoff hygiene matters as much as the feature: stray `repoos.toml` and foreign `work/` edits block landing even when UI verification passes. Restoring those from `main` before handoff is part of finishing the task.

For pipeline cards, UI state (`displayState`) should drive recency visibility, not only the coarse `state` prop from the parent mapper, whenever shared status can promote “paused” or “stuck” overlays.
